decision.chosen: Recommend one existing Python3 standard-library guest process outside target cgroup, writing directly to a bounded journal in a new owned directory on the already shared worktrees mount. Retain existing host Node spawnSync/Docker CLI capture and independent postguards; add small synchronous boundary calls and only one sh marker+exec adaptation to the verify command.
decision.flow: host boundary request -> shared control -> guest sample/journal/fsync/ACK -> host existing synchronous command; journal writes continue independently of host event loop. Verify return -> immediate sampled ACK -> root-marker retrieval/artifact copy -> original independent postguards.
decision.language: Rust remains preferred generally and LexLean remains the only product implementation. A usable guest Rust toolchain/binary is not established; introducing a compiler/cross-build solely for this diagnostic adds tooling/storage/ABI work forbidden by its scope. Existing Python stdlib supplies bounded binary IO, integer arithmetic, guest clock, fsync and rename without per-sample helper processes. This is a diagnostic-only recommendation, not Python application code, an SDK/PrismPM fallback or a new service. Revalidate the pinned existing runtime before use; do not install/fall back silently.
decision.envelope: One observer file and focused tests; one narrow existing invocation adaptation; one inline sh wrapper. No daemon, Docker API/event subsystem, generic runner, tracing framework or third-party package.
decision.retainedContract: Keep fixed cgroup/33-module scope, finite read/object limits, sparse compact journal, explicit gaps/unknowns,1MiB total,100ms target cadence,5s slow samples and strict absolute-zero guards. No omitted unknown keys or overwritten trace to manufacture coverage.

rootBinding.choice: Parent-proposed marker+exec is the smallest defensible source direction, conditional on the tests below. It avoids async executor or Docker event/API machinery. A pre-exec marker is not itself successful-exec evidence.
rootBinding.marker: A new exclusive0600 marker, <=4096B, in an owned container location outside all50 source inputs and selected project source tree records version, fresh nonce, own $$ and raw /proc/$$/stat. Use a shell builtin read aimed at /proc/$$/stat, not cat /proc/self. Preserve raw bytes. No overwrite or reused marker/root; exact path must be fixed by the reviewed invocation.
rootBinding.launch: After successful marker setup and required immediate all-zero admission, exec exact original lexlean argv with unchanged cwd/env/stdout/stderr. No backgrounding, extra subshell, retries or timeout wrapper. Preserve all original guards. Marker/zero-read/exec order requires explicit review; do not claim atomic read-and-exec or ignore a newly nonzero sample.
rootBinding.retrieval: After synchronous verify returns, obtain immediate return sample/ACK before marker retrieval or artifact copy. Then retrieve bounded marker using existing Docker read/copy path with its own boundary/status/bytes. Nonce mismatch, stale/duplicate/overlong/missing marker, changed epoch or failed retrieval blocks binding. No live root discovery is required to let the healthy compiler finish.
rootBinding.schemaRefinement: Add a bounded raw NSpid vector to each identity alongside guestPID/startticks/membership/observed parent. Missing or unvalidated namespace data remains unknown. Version the schema and include new fields, container marker, host copy and retrieval receipts in the unchanged total quota; existing dictionary arithmetic is not automatically sufficient.
rootBinding.exactJoin: Require unchanged guestboot/container epoch/cgroup; exclusive valid nonce marker; marker innerPID equal to the observed NSpid inner coordinate under independently exercised namespace mapping; exact marker/observer starttick equality; stable double-read PID/start/membership; exactly one matching observed incarnation. Retrospectively bind only actually observed incarnation-bound ancestor edges. An exited/unseen/ambiguous parent or identity stays owned_unattributed. No broad /proc scan or unrelated parent argv read.
rootBinding.execDistinction: A pre-exec marker only names the shell incarnation. Successful replacement additionally needs actual successful SDK outcome/artifact or an observed lexlean argv transition on that bound incarnation. Wrapper setup/exec failure is an instrument failure, not a semantic negative. Root ancestry supports observed overlap, never sole allocation causality. Matching argv/time alone is insufficient.
rootBinding.validation: A separately authorized harmless wrapper fixture must test unchanged PID/start through exec, cross-namespace NSpid/start mapping and its failure cases, exact marker custody, unchanged stdout/stderr, failed exec and no source-input effects. No such wrapper test ran here. If it fails or any field is unavailable, retain owned_unattributed and do not claim SPEC-01 discharged. No automatic broader subsystem or diagnostic launch.

ioAndBounds.path: Use the existing shared mount and a fresh0700 owned directory/0600 files, no symlink components. Independently check host/guest paths,UID/mode/mount and nonce exchange; never equate host and guest dev/inode numbers. Preserve old capability directories/evidence.
ioAndBounds.boundaries: Use one guest CLOCK_BOOTTIME domain and nonce/monotone-sequence requests/ACKs. Contract<=2s host wait remains bounded; preverify required ACK failure blocks launch. During/after verification, observer failure marks insufficient coverage but never interrupts healthy compiler. Return sample precedes extra Docker retrieval/copy. Host and guest monotonic clocks are not directly comparable.
ioAndBounds.persistence: Journal is the evidence channel. Concrete launch must bound or discard auxiliary stdout/stderr rather than retain an unbounded fallback. Test partial writes, exclusive creation, same-directory atomic replacement and fsync/error handling; fsync completion is an observed API result, not proof of power-loss durability over virtiofs/APFS. Preserve complete prefix and reserved guest/host terminal statuses.
ioAndBounds.totalQuota: Count all journal/dictionaries/control temps/terminals plus the new container marker, its host copy and retrieval observation receipt within1MiB. Reserve added marker costs before sampling; separately account filesystem allocation rounding. No ring buffer, compression shortcut, budget increase or cadence reduction by default.
ioAndBounds.transientMemory: Contract190465B arena arithmetic is not a Python object/RSS proof. Bound input reads and current identity state; never keep full trace/all argv in heap. Account strings,base64,JSON and write copies; test transient allocation. Metadata maxrss is not observer-overhead evidence. Outside-cgroup placement does not remove shared VM/cache contention.
ioAndBounds.capFailure: On quota/read/object limit stop observation only, retain typed truncation, complete prefix and terminal reserve. No signal/suspend/reprioritization/timeout extension of compiler; no automatic second diagnostic. Missing attribution can make result insufficient.
